fusions.name: Scratch Pile
fusions.desc: Rakes the haft in a circle, dealing 11 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and making each [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on them spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Windrow Haul
fusions.desc: Drags the tines along the ground to the target, dealing 8 damage, up to 1.4 times that at maximum range. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Raked Clear
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 conditions from you.

fusions.name: Gleanings
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you restore 8 stamina. Once every 4 seconds.
